descriptionChirho: The personal name Uzza or Uzzah (Hebrew uzza, meaning 'strength'), referring primarily to the man who touched the Ark and was struck dead (2 Sam 6 / 1 Chr 13), and also to other individuals bearing this name. All four clusters are the same proper noun with different prepositional prefixes and conjunctions. S123193 is the bare name 'Uzza' (Arabic uzza, Korean utsa, Swahili Uza), S123194 adds the preposition 'against Uzzah' (Arabic ala-uzza, Swahili dhidi ya Uza), S123197 adds conjunctive waw 'and Uzzah' (Arabic wa-uzza, Swahili na Uza), and S123199 is simply the variant spelling 'Uzzah.' Korean shows minor transliteration variants (utsa/yutse) but all refer to the same person(s).
